implementation: Apple corecrypto Module [Apple silicon, Kernel, Software, SL1] (vng_ltc)
description: Cryptographic library offering various cryptographic mechanisms to Apple frameworks in the XNU kernel. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized block mode and compound ciphers with ARM VNG AES / hash assembler implementation.
